decisions: All three generic roles share the compiled CSharp inline-size policy; metadata layout remains separate from runtime admission.
Closed runtime name projection remains strict. Explicit signature projection consumes the existing signature identity map and compiled generic display names.
Products use ordered fields and normal aggregate padding; Option/Result payload words use the largest inline payload rounded to eight-byte words.
Abstract metadata records and their role aliases require separate identities beyond the concrete runtime arena; runtime type flags and runtime cache admission are not weakened.
